_note: S1 (2026-11-10), see mesen2-results/S1_20261110.md. Static checks only. (1) InitGravity: eight of the 25 shipped calls use a nonzero offset operand; none has bit 7 set. (2) BranchIfItemEquipped: the read with index $FFFF is bank $82 offset $0AB3 (16-bit index carry into the data bank), not an in-bank wrap. (3) dialog_dictionaries: the rebuild rule is now traced. (4) LoopEnd: the last pass does not yield. (5) combat_collision: two skip-mask comments omit bit $0200 and others. edit.with: Eight of the 25 shipped calls use a nonzero offset (#01 to #03 and #05, in pyDD_queen_debris, sg55_viper, sg4E_nitropede and sg4D_dynapede); none has bit 7 set, so the negating branch is never taken by shipped scripts.

edit.find: the indexed read wraps to $0AB3 — the byte before the array — so the compare reads unrelated data (analysis only, unverified at runtime).
edit.with: the 16-bit index carries into the data-bank byte, so the read is bank $82 (DBR is $81) offset $0AB3, a mirror of WRAM $0AB3, the byte before the array. That byte is the high byte of the word $0AB2 that DarkSpaceMainInit stores (the room variant 0 to 3, so the high byte is 0); no other writer of $0AB3 was found, so none of the operand item ids ($0F, $1C, $27 at the five sites) matches and the branch is not taken (static reading, not run).

edit.find: how the compressor decides which words to substitute was not traced (OQ-I070-1). Frequency of use of individual words was not measured.
edit.with: the rebuild recomputes the substitutions: it merges the 456 words of both tables, sorts them by length, longest first (words of equal length keep table order, table A first), and replaces every occurrence of each word anywhere in the string, with no word-boundary test, by the two bytes $D6 or $D7 followed by the word index. A string that is exactly one dictionary word is stored as plain characters, and strings marked raw are not substituted. Frequency of use of individual words was not measured.

edit.with: yields via RTL: every pass except the last ends with a yield, and the last pass continues into the code after the loop in the same frame.
